_comment: ADR-037 register fragment (forms-service-fetch-for-apps Task 1, spec REQ-SF-001, design D2). Declares `serviceFetch`: a named call another app may ask integriq to make, with declared inputs, an output mapping and the apps allowed to call it. The object names a source, a path and mappings, so the authorization block is the lockdown shape of 99-mail-schemas-lockdown.json: four EMPTY rule lists deny everyone except the `admin` group and an object's owner. ServiceFetchService reads fetches in system context (`_rbac: false`) on behalf of the calling app, and ServiceFetchController projects them for designers without source, path, query or mappings. Also adds `context` to `call_log`, the calling app and fetch slug of a fetch's call (design D4). Does NOT edit lib/Settings/integriq_register.json.

serviceFetch.title: Service fetch
serviceFetch.summary: A named call another app may ask integriq to make
serviceFetch.description: A service fetch takes named inputs, calls one integriq source with them and answers named outputs through an output mapping. An app asks for it by slug; it never sees the source, its credential or the raw answer. See openspec/changes/forms-service-fetch-for-apps/design.md D2.

slug.description: The name an app asks for the fetch by. Unique.
slug.title: Slug

title.description: The name a form designer sees.
title.title: Title

description.description: What the fetch answers, for a form designer.
description.title: Description

source.description: The integriq source the fetch calls.
source.title: Source

method.description: The HTTP method of the call.
method.title: Method

path.description: The path relative to the source location, with {input} placeholders.
path.title: Path

query.description: Query parameter name to template, with {input} placeholders.
query.title: Query

bodyMapping.description: A mapping from the inputs to the request body. POST only.
bodyMapping.title: Body mapping

inputs.description: The inputs an app passes. Undeclared inputs are dropped.
inputs.title: Inputs

outputMapping.description: A mapping from the answer, given as {status, body}, to the outputs.
outputMapping.title: Output mapping

outputs.description: The outputs an app receives. Anything the mapping writes outside this list is dropped.
outputs.title: Outputs

allowedApps.description: The app ids that may call the fetch. Empty means none.
allowedApps.title: Allowed apps

timeoutMs.description: How long the call may take, in milliseconds. At most 15000.
timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)

cacheSeconds.description: How long an answer is reused for the same inputs. 0 is not at all.
cacheSeconds.title: Cache (seconds)

context.description: Who asked for the call, when another app did: the calling app and the service fetch slug (forms-service-fetch-for-apps design D4).
context.title: Context
